content:
Below is a concise, up‑to‑date (October 2025) snapshot of the people who are generally regarded as **members of the current British Royal Family** – i.e., those who hold royal titles or are the direct descendants of recent monarchs – together with the name of **each person’s father**.  

| Royal family member (title) | Relationship to the monarch | Father |
|-----------------------------|----------------------------|--------|
| **King Charles III** | Monarch (succeeded 2022) | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (the late husband of Queen Elizabeth II) |
| **Queen Camilla** (Queen Consort) | Wife of the monarch | **Bruce Shand** (British Army officer & landowner) |
| **Prince William, Prince of Wales** | Eldest son of the monarch | **King Charles III** |
| **Catherine, Princess of Wales** | Wife of the Prince of Wales | **Michael Middleton** |
| **Prince George of Wales** | Eldest son of the Prince & Princess of Wales | **Prince William** |
| **Princess Charlotte of Wales** | Daughter of the Prince & Princess of Wales | **Prince William** |
| **Prince Louis of Wales** | Son of the Prince & Princess of Wales | **Prince William** |
| **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** | Younger son of the monarch | **King Charles III** |
| **Meghan, Duchess of Sussex** | Wife of the Duke of Sussex | **Thomas Markle Sr.** |
| **Archie Harrison Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Son of the Duke & Duchess of Sussex | **Prince Harry** |
| **Lilibet “Lili” Diana Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Daughter of the Duke & Duchess of Sussex | **Prince Harry** |
| **Princess Anne, The Princess Royal** | Daughter of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **King George VI** |
| **Sir Timothy Laurence** (her husband) | Husband of the Princess Royal | — (not a royal by birth) |
| **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** | Son of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **King George VI** |
| **Sarah, Duchess of York** (former) | Ex‑wife of the Duke of York | **Sir Ronald Ferguson** |
| **Princess Beatrice, Mrs Mapelli Mozzi** | Daughter of the Duke of York | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Edoardo Mapelli Mozzi** (her husband) | Husband of Princess Beatrice | — (not a royal by birth) |
| **Sienna Mapelli‑Mozzi** (daughter) | Granddaughter of the Duke of York | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Princess Eugenie, Mrs Jack Brooksbank** | Daughter of the Duke of York | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Jack Brooksbank** (her husband) | Husband of Princess Eugenie | — (not a royal by birth) |
| **August Brooksbank** (son) | Grandson of the Duke of York | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex** (now **Prince Edward, Duke of Edinburgh**) | Son of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **King George VI** |
| **Sophie, Duchess of Edinburgh** | Wife of the Earl/Duke of Edinburgh | **David Roche** |
| **Lady Louise Windsor** | Daughter of the Earl/Duke of Edinburgh | **Prince Edward** |
| **James, Viscount Severn** | Son of the Earl/Duke of Edinburgh | **Prince Edward** |
| **Prince Michael of Kent** | Cousin of the late Queen Elizabeth II (descended from King George V) | **Prince George, Duke of Kent** |
| **Princess Michael of Kent** (her husband) | Wife of Prince Michael of Kent | — (not a royal by birth) |
| **Lord Frederick Windsor** | Son of Prince Michael & Princess Michael of Kent | **Prince Michael of Kent** |
| **Lady Gabriella Kingston** | Daughter of Prince Michael & Princess Michael of Kent | **Prince Michael of Kent** |
| **Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester** | First cousin once removed of the late Queen Elizabeth II (descended from King George V) | **Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester** |
| **Birgitte, Duchess of Gloucester** | Wife of the Duke of Gloucester | — (not a royal by birth) |
| **Alexander Windsor, Earl of Ulster** | Son of the Duke & Duchess of Gloucester | **Prince Richard** |
| **Lady Davina Windsor** | Daughter of the Duke & Duchess of Gloucester | **Prince Richard** |
| **Lady Rose Gilman** | Daughter of the Duke & Duchess of Gloucester | **Prince Richard** |

### How the list was compiled
* **Core “working” royals** – the monarch, his children, grandchildren, and the monarch’s siblings (Princess Anne, Prince Andrew, Prince Edward) – are included because they hold official titles, undertake royal duties and appear on the official website of the British Monarchy.  
* **Spouses** are listed because they are styled as royals (e.g., Princess of Wales, Duchess of Sussex) even though they are not blood‑related.  
* **Descendants of the monarch’s siblings** (the children of Prince Andrew, the children of Prince Edward, and the children of Princess Anne) are also considered members of the Royal Family, as they are in the line of succession and receive HRH style (or, in the case of Princess Anne’s children, are “princes/princesses of the United Kingdom”).  
* **More distant cousins** – Prince Michael of Kent, Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester and their immediate children – are traditionally counted among the “Royal Family” because they are the senior members of the extended House of Windsor who retain the style “His/Her Royal Highness.” They are included here for completeness.  

### Note on fathers
* For every person listed, the father is a **male member of the House of Windsor** (or, in the case of spouses, the father’s name is given for context even though the spouse is not a royal by birth).  
* The list reflects the situation **as of October 2025**; any future births, deaths or changes in titles after that date are not reflected.  

If you need a narrower focus (e.g., only the “working royals” who regularly perform official duties) or additional details such as mothers, dates of birth, or current titles, just let me know!
